notes: Stream the show (new Stream button): a live video stream, like a network camera, for VLC, a browser, OpenCV or a detector: MJPEG over HTTP (the lowest delay), RTSP (H.264) or both.
Stream: viewers on this computer only or on other devices too; size, frame rate, quality, the info text, a clock in the corner; stop it by hand, after a set time or at a date and time.
While streaming, the show keeps its frame rate and keeps running when its window is hidden. When the stream stops, viewers are told (VLC ends playback).
RTSP needs ffmpeg: Start streaming offers to download it (or streams MJPEG only).
Preset schedule (Presets > Preset schedule): saved presets one after another, each for its own time (5 minutes to 24 hours); start with the show or at a date and time.
Preset schedule: the next preset's images are prepared in the background, so there is no loading screen between steps.
The memory chart can show CPU instead (the app and its effects process), with an orange strip where the stream was on.
Logs: Copy copies the lines shown (all, or those matching the filter); Clear clears the filter.
Fixed: effects (rotation, projective and the others) jumped back for a moment when the show resumed after a pause, and ahead after Editor mode or an export started from a paused show.
Fixed: closing the app while streaming could hang.
Fixed: on a PC where the antivirus checks a new version for a long time, the effects process gave up instead of waiting.
Fixed: in Editor mode the image menu (Open in Paint / Delete image) could close at once.
If the show stops responding, logs/crash.log says whether Windows held it up or the app was busy.
Fixed: the show could freeze when Camera Shake was combined with some other effects (for example Fog, Rain & Dirt, or Occlusion); the Effects preview could freeze the same way.
Fixed: near the left and top edges, the padding between two images could disappear (one pixel).
Settings: each group of settings is in its own box.
If the effects process cannot start right away (a very busy PC), it is tried again instead of leaving the effects to the app for the whole session.
If the show ever stops responding, logs/crash.log now records where: please attach it to a bug report.
Updates work on networks that block namtpham.github.io: the app now also checks for new versions on github.com.
Help > Releases on GitHub opens the downloads on GitHub.
When the website cannot be reached, the update notice's Website button opens the GitHub release page instead.
First public release.
Objects: a folder of images per object (or downloaded images), shown as a grid of tiles scrolling in 8 directions; Individual, Random mix, Row-wise and Column-wise display.

Effects for each object, like a real camera: zoom and pan, rotation, projective transform, camera shake, motion blur, defocus, lens distortion, color and exposure, noise, compression, flicker, fog / rain / dirt, glare, occlusion patches, partial view, low resolution. Random timing per image, and a Coverage share of tiles.
Export the show as a video; Capture (Ctrl + G) saves the current picture as a PNG.
Presets, Editor mode (delete or edit images on the screen), speed schedule, transitions, flip / mirror / rotate, fullscreen on the chosen monitor.
Smooth and light: effects in their own process, effects at 30 fps if wanted, the show pauses while its window is hidden.
Settings: images per download, maximum images per object, folder watching, performance options.
Updates: Help > Check for updates, and an automatic check once a day (can be turned off in Settings). Update now downloads the new version and restarts, keeping your images, settings and presets.
